digest.component_or_area: LLM provider framework / OpenAI-compatible endpoint support
propositions: _pai_check_config raises loudly on any base_url or api_key configuration, blocking OpenAI-compatible local endpoints despite config parsing and documentation claiming support
the builder must register OpenAI provider only when cfg.base_url is set, preserving the lazy model-string path for bare openai: strings without custom endpoints
a rebar OpenAIProvider subclass must override model_profile to withdraw supports_json_schema_output=False while preserving other capabilities, making strict output inaccessible for opaque endpoints

the documented recipe REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER=openai + REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL=http://localhost:1234/v1 must construct an OpenAIChatModel with the custom base URL and injected api_key, achieving end-to-end structured output
base_url must not become a provider selector—it remains configuration only, with provider selection driven by the model string and REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER env var
pydantic-ai-slim[openai] must be added to dev extra only, keeping the agents runtime extra lean and preserving opt-in posture for end users
